rapid_barrage.name: Rapid Barrage
rapid_barrage.desc: Fire five rapid Ki blasts down your row.

scatter_shot.name: Scatter Shot
scatter_shot.desc: Launch one heavy blast down every row at once.

energy_wave.name: Energy Wave
energy_wave.desc: Charge, then fire a beam across your whole row. Can clash with enemy beams.

final_burst.name: Final Burst
final_burst.desc: A colossal beam that engulfs your row and the rows beside it.

meteor_rush.name: Meteor Rush
meteor_rush.desc: Vanish to the enemy's tile for a four-hit combo that knocks them back.

explosive_aura.name: Explosive Aura
explosive_aura.desc: Detonate a 3x3 blast centred three tiles ahead. Cracks the ground.

ground_seize.name: Ground Seize
ground_seize.desc: Capture the enemy's front column for a while, shrinking their territory.

afterimage.name: Afterimage
afterimage.desc: For 6 seconds, automatically vanish away from the next attack that would hit you.

energy_charge.name: Energy Charge
energy_charge.desc: Focus briefly to restore 60 Ki. A heavy hit interrupts it.

power_ascension.name: Power Ascension
power_ascension.desc: Rise to your next form right away, without waiting for your power gauge to fill.

tracking_volley.name: Tracking Volley
tracking_volley.desc: Three blasts, each aimed at whichever row your opponent is in when it fires.

piercing_lance.name: Piercing Lance
piercing_lance.desc: A lightning-fast lance of Ki down your row. It cannot be blocked.

nova_sphere.name: Nova Sphere
nova_sphere.desc: A slow, giant orb that bursts over a 3x3 area when it reaches your opponent. Ploughs through blasts and cracks the ground.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.desc: Ki meteors rain on five enemy tiles one after another. The first lands where your opponent stands.

quake_stomp.name: Quake Stomp
quake_stomp.desc: Stamp a shockwave through the enemy's two front columns. Anyone caught in it is stunned.

titan_throw.name: Titan Throw
titan_throw.desc: Grab an opponent within punching reach and hurl them to the back of their side. Unblockable, and they land stunned.

iron_body.name: Iron Body
iron_body.desc: For 6 seconds take half damage, and hits cannot stagger or stun you.

battle_cry.name: Battle Cry
battle_cry.desc: For 6 seconds every attack you land hits 50% harder.

binding_ray.name: Binding Ray
binding_ray.desc: A fast ray down your row that stuns your opponent for over a second.

soul_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
soul_siphon.desc: A draining orb aimed at your opponent's row. On a hit it steals up to 30 of their Ki.

mending_breath.name: Mending Breath
mending_breath.desc: Breathe deep to recover 70 Health. A heavy hit interrupts it.

mirror_ward.name: Mirror Ward
mirror_ward.desc: For 4 seconds every projectile that reaches you is sent back, techniques included. Beams still get through.

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
shadow_step.desc: Become a shadow for 4 seconds: you can't be hurt, and you can walk onto your opponent's tiles. When it ends you return to your own ground.

grapple_hook.name: Grapple
grapple_hook.desc: Shoot a grapple hook down your row. If it catches your opponent, it reels you both to the front line and you unleash your full three-punch combo. It can't be blocked, but a blast can knock it away.

combos.name: Triple Energy Barrage
combos.desc: Three Energy techniques fuse into a storm of blasts across every row.

combos.name: Twin Surge Wave
combos.desc: Two Energy Waves merge into a wide beam covering neighbouring rows.

combos.name: Comet Breaker
combos.desc: Meteor Rush ends in an explosion that shatters the ground around the target.

combos.name: Meteor Storm
combos.desc: Two Starfalls become a storm of nine meteors that crack the ground where they land.

combos.name: Fortress Stance
combos.desc: Iron Body and Battle Cry together: for 7 seconds take half damage, shrug off staggers and hit 50% harder.

combos.name: Soul Prison
combos.desc: Binding Ray and Soul Siphon fuse into rays down every row that stun and drain whoever they hit.
